name: Toujou Noa
source:
3rd year high school student, part of the health committee.
He's usually cool and unsociable.
He doesn't express it much but he thinks the protagonist is most important to him, and he acts like a supportive big brother.
He has confidence in his grades and loves girls with twin tails.
